about: Unscheduled recommendations by SIFMA (or, before 2006, its predecessor the Bond Market Association) that neither SIFMA's archive page nor its 1996-2019 PDF lists. Covers no years: it only adds these dates.

exceptions.note: "The bond market is also expected to be closed Wednesday, following a recommendation by the Bond Market Association to do so." Trading stopped after the attacks that morning; Treasury published no par yield curve for September 11 or 12 (mkt-data phase 2, B6).
Closed on the Bond Market Association's recommendation (above); "Trading of Treasury securities resumes Thursday" (CNN, https://money.cnn.com/2001/09/12/markets/reopen/), so September 13.
"The bond market will also be closed." Treasury published no par yield curve that day (mkt-data phase 2, B6).

exceptions.holiday: National Day of Mourning (President Carter) (early close)
exceptions.note: Recommended December 30, 2024: a 2:00 p.m. Eastern early close for all fixed-income cash markets.
